ANALYZE.description: Reproduce failure, read logs/traces, identify root cause. Read docs/hbm-bank-interleaving.md before making any hypothesis.
checklist: vecadd failure reproduced with xrt_vcs (or confirmed from recent run)
Error type identified (compile error / sim hang / data mismatch / crash)
Root cause hypothesis written in STATUS.md with evidence

transitions.IMPLEMENT: Root cause identified with fix plan
transitions.DONE: No fix needed — test already passes

IMPLEMENT.description: Apply the fix. RTL changes via RTL Implementation subagent, C++/sim changes directly. Log all modified files in STATUS.md.
checklist: All modified files listed in STATUS.md
Change description explains what and why

VERIFY.description: Run vecadd blackbox test with xrt_vcs, BANK_INTERLEAVE ON, 8 HBM ports. Use configs from docs/port-scale/how-to-test.md.
checklist: vecadd blackbox command and exit code logged in STATUS.md
If PASS: IPC and instruction count recorded
If FAIL: error output captured in STATUS.md

DONE.description: vecadd passes with BANK_INTERLEAVE ON. Update STATUS.md with final result.
